description: Find California Office of Tax Appeals (OTA) opinions by statute citation or topic keyword (e.g. "residency", "innocent spouse", "17014", "17951-4", "generative AI") -- returns citation, title, date, tax category (Franchise/Income vs Business Tax), precedential status, and OTA's own one-line issue/statute tag, most recent first with an exact phrase match ranked above a looser match. Matches every word of `query` (any order), with a small bidirectional synonym table for OTA's own shorthand (e.g. "GenAI" <-> "generative AI" <-> "AI" <-> "artificial intelligence"). Use `year` for "opinions from 2026" rather than putting the year in `query` text -- it almost never appears inside an opinion's title or Issues tag. PARTIAL: this searches opinion titles and OTA's published "Issues" tag only, not full opinion text (OTA publishes no full-text search). For full text and all cited provisions of a specific opinion, use ca_ota_opinion_lookup. Sourced from ota.ca.gov's own opinion listing pages.

category.description: Optional filter: "fit" (Franchise and Income Tax, FTB-administered) or "bt" (Business Tax, CDTFA-administered: sales/use, excise, etc).

limit.description: Max opinions to return, default 25, max 100.

precedential_only.description: If true, only return opinions OTA has designated Precedential (binding on future OTA panels). Default false (returns both).

query.description: A topic keyword (e.g. "residency", "penalties", "innocent spouse", "generative AI") or a statute citation/number (e.g. "17014" or "R&TC 19045"). May be omitted if you only need `year`/`category`/`precedential_only` filters. A bare year inside this text (e.g. "2026") is treated as a `year` filter, not as text to match.

year.description: Optional filter: only opinions issued in this calendar year, e.g. 2026. Prefer this over putting the year inside `query` -- OTA's own title/Issues tag almost never repeats the year.

name: ca_ota_search
title: Ca Ota Search
